question: Should iOS and Watch Debug builds use separate bundle identifiers, app group storage, URL scheme, and icon/name by default once the i18n and changelog cleanup is fixed?
rationale: This changes developer build identity, signing, and local Debug state separation; that is a maintainer-owned app/release workflow choice, not only a code-style fix.

options.title: Adopt default Debug isolation
options.body: Keep the separate Debug identifiers and storage as the default, after fixing generated inventory/localization and release-note ownership.

options.title: Make Debug isolation opt-in
options.body: Require an explicit local signing/build setting for the separate Debug identity so existing developer installs keep current behavior by default.

options.title: Keep shared Debug/Release identity
options.body: Do not merge the identity split and rely only on build artifacts or visual cues that do not alter bundle IDs or app groups.

recommendation.title: Adopt default Debug isolation
recommendation.body: Keep the separate Debug identifiers and storage as the default, after fixing generated inventory/localization and release-note ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, and prior iOS app history shows steipete as a recurring owner of the app identity and UX surface.
